name: PortalRevealPanel
description: Clip-path iris and geometric portal entrance animation supporting multiple origin coordinates, staggered child reveals, and clean unmount choreography.
a11yNotes: Links the toggle trigger to the revealed region via aria-expanded and aria-controls, and falls back to an instant opacity toggle when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

propsApi.name: origin
propsApi.description: Origin coordinate for the circular clip-path expansion.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Duration in seconds for the clip-path transition.

propsApi.name: staggerChildren
propsApi.description: Delay in seconds between inner child reveals.
